name: object_color
description: Name the typical colour of a common object, few-shot 'Object: X. Color: Y'. Control: same format copying the object name ('Name: X').
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
P=[('banana','yellow'),('grass','green'),('sky','blue'),('snow','white'),('coal','black'),('blood','red'),('carrot','orange'),('chocolate','brown'),('lemon','yellow'),('tomato','red'),('milk','white'),('crow','black'),('emerald','green'),('sapphire','blue'),('pumpkin','orange'),('strawberry','red'),('lime','green'),('ink','black'),('cloud','white'),('eggplant','purple'),('lavender','purple'),('flamingo','pink'),('ruby','red'),('charcoal','black'),('ocean','blue'),('cucumber','green'),('sunflower','yellow'),('cherry','red'),('frog','green'),('tangerine','orange'),('soil','brown'),('coffee','brown'),('cotton','white'),('raven','black'),('broccoli','green'),('blueberry','blue'),('canary','yellow'),('salt','white'),('fire truck','red'),('mud','brown')]
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    s=random.sample(P,4)
    items.append({"prompt":"\n".join(f"Object: {o}. Color: {c}" for o,c in s[:3])+f"\nObject: {s[3][0]}. Color:","answer":" "+s[3][1]})
    s=random.sample(P,4)
    control.append({"prompt":"\n".join(f"Object: {o}. Name: {o}" for o,c in s[:3])+f"\nObject: {s[3][0]}. Name:","answer":" "+s[3][0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
